How it fits together

From first click to booked visit.

  1. Add a tool

    A widget on your site answers the question customers ask most: what rebates can I get, or what will this cost?

  2. Capture the lead

    To see their full result, visitors leave their email and project details. It goes straight to your sales team.

  3. Book the visit

    Your team follows up with a quote or an on-site assessment, already knowing what the customer wants.

  4. Drive traffic

    Digital ads send the right homeowners to the tool, and you see the cost of every lead in plain numbers.
